QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h` has both `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` (line 3787) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) commented out.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both macros as the ones gating threading support (disabled in the default config; THREADING_C guards the code, PTHREAD selects the backend).
